import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)]


def minimum_promise(values,level):
 lo,hi=0,300
 while lo<hi:
  mid=(lo+hi)//2
  if np.mean(values>mid)<=level: hi=mid
  else: lo=mid+1
 return int(lo)
promise={}; late_at_promise={}; q90={}
for kind,g in ok.groupby('courier'):
 values=g['actual_min'].values
 promise[kind]=minimum_promise(values,.1)
 late_at_promise[kind]=round(float(np.mean(values>promise[kind])),3)
 q90[kind]=float(np.quantile(values,.9))
slowest=max(promise,key=promise.get)
